Sonically the Big Puft is an amalgam of Zach's preferred BMP circuits. It has a smooth and moderate amount of gain, a ton of output if needed and a tone stack that is more mid forward so you aren't as lost in a mix. Complete with True Bypass switching on a Keymaster inspired PCB. The Big Puft is not a toy. Don't let the Big Puft playful appearance fool you, this is an aggressive and versatile fuzz pedal. Each of the controls on this unit have been tweaked to give you the most control possible. From mellow distortion to annihilating fuzz the Big Puft is deceptive in it's simplicity and with a quick press of the footswitch you'll be crossing the tone streams in no time. Get the tools for your talent with the new Mythos Big Puft Fuzz Device. The Big Puft is a homage to the incredible BMP fuzz circuit we all know and love just with a unique Mythos twist. Sonically Zach and the team at Mythos have tweaked the circuit to have a full and more mid forward voice so that the days of getting lost in the mix with this style of fuzz are long gone. The Tone knob on the Big Puft has been tuned so that in the middle position you have a much flatter EQ sound, but once you reduce or increase the position on the knob you immediately find some of those classic fuzz sounds this style of pedal is known for. Like all Mythos pedals we strive to make every knob have the best function and taper possible. We made sure the Sustain control has a wide array of gain sounds, so you can take the Big Puft to mellow and smooth to searing levels of fuzz. While inspired by the iconic BMP circuit, the Puft is sort of an amalgam of our favorite sounds that pedal has.
